I see. The check `builtInTypeId > SOPC_BUILTINID_MAX + 1` allows `builtInTypeId == SOPC_BUILTINID_MAX + 1` (26), but the tables are sized `SOPC_BUILTINID_MAX + 1` (26 elements, indices 0-25). So index 26 is out of bounds.

But wait - the fuzzer uses `buf[0] % SOPC_TypeInternalIndex_SIZE` to select the encodeable type, and then decodes it. The OOB in builtintype tables would occur during decode of a variant that has a builtin type id of 26. Let me look at the variant decode path. Let me look at lines 2540-2620.
